'''Dagannoth Rex''' is the [[Melee]]-based [[Dagannoth King]] found in the depths of the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]], along with fellow Dagannoth Kings, [[Dagannoth Supreme]] and [[Dagannoth Prime]]. Rex is the only monster to drop the [[Berserker ring|Berserker]] and [[Warrior ring]]s. He, along with the other [[Dagannoth (race)|Dagannoth]] Kings, can also drop the rare [[dragon axe]].

Dagannoth Rex spawns and roams on the south-eastern side of the Dagannoth Kings' lair. The lair is accessible via the [[Kings' ladder]] deep within the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]]. A separate lair where players that have a Dagannoth [[Slayer task]] can attack the Kings is accessible by using the "Slayer" option on the ladder. The lair can be peeked at to see if other players are inside it via the ladder and a [[Crack (Waterbirth Island Dungeon)|crack]] inside a safe room nearby the ladder.

==Strategy==
{{Main|Dagannoth Kings/Strategies}}
[[File:Dagannoth Rex safespot.png|thumb|left|Luring Rex to a safespot.]]
Dagannoth Rex has an extremely low [[Magic Defence]], so it is recommended to use [[Magic]] against him. Popular choices include [[Magic Dart]], [[Iban Blast]], [[powered staves]], and [[Earth spells]].

Due to his large size and the fact he uses [[melee]] attacks only, it is recommended to get him stuck on one of the ridges of the lair and [[safespot]] him (note that [[Spinolyp]]s will still be constantly attacking while you're safespotting). Many players use high-level [[armour]] such as [[Barrows armour]], which give high [[Defence]] bonuses while still being able to hit Rex constantly with [[spells]] due to his very low Magic Defence, even if their [[magic attack bonus]] is below zero. Players who use [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's]] are advised to heal themselves on the Spinolyps while waiting on respawns to help preserve [[food]] and [[potions]].

If players venture too far out west to lure Dagannoth Rex, they risk attracting attention from both [[Dagannoth Prime]] and [[Dagannoth Supreme]]. Prime is the bigger threat since he wanders closer to the east and north-east. This can be avoided by staying in the south-eastern part of the arena, as Prime will rarely (if ever) go there, and attack Rex only when he's nearest to the east. Players should use '''caution''' even while in the safe area. Others may attempt to kill you with [[Dagannoth Prime]]'s AOE attack.
